title: What Shapes Learner Outcomes?
description: A learner’s outcomes are shaped across multiple, interconnected layers.
layerFootnote: *Click any layer or tile to know more.
chipFootnote: *Click any layer or tile to know more.
frameworkLead: Accordingly, the Shikshagraha movement defines and measures impact across four interconnected layers, each representing a critical level through which micro-improvements contribute to systemic transformation:
programChipFootnote: * Click on any of the above tile to read more about it.
defaultNarrativeBody: Tap a layer to see what it means.

layers.heading: Learner Outcomes
layers.subheading: Measures whether children are experiencing improved learning outcomes through better access, learning, well-being, aspirations, and future readiness.
layers.body: The learner is at the centre of change and actively shapes their own learning journey. Their participation, engagement, agency and time spent meaningfully involved in learning directly influence the outcomes they experience.

listItems.title: Enrollment
listItems.description: Are more children accessing public education?

listItems.title: Retention
listItems.description: Are children consistently attending and remaining in school?

listItems.title: Learning
listItems.description: Are children demonstrating improved academic and holistic learning outcomes along with future ready skills?

listItems.title: Aspiration & agency
listItems.description: Are children developing confidence, future aspirations, and awareness of opportunities?

listItems.title: Well-being
listItems.description: Are children experiencing emotional, physical, and social well-being in school?

layers.learner_subheading: The learner is at the centre of change and actively shapes their own learning journey. Their participation, engagement, agency and time spent meaningfully involved in learning directly influence the outcomes they experience.
layers.impact_subheading: Measures whether children are experiencing improved learning outcomes through better access, learning, well-being, aspirations, and future readiness.

layers.heading: Schools & Anganwadi Centres
layers.subheading: Measures whether schools and Anganwadi centres are fostering quality learning through effective leadership, enabling learning environments, and strong teaching and learning practices.
layers.body: Schools and Anganwadi centres shape learner outcomes by creating the day-to-day conditions in which learner learn, participate and develop. The quality of leadership, teaching and learning practices, relationships, and learning environment determines whether learner’s needs are understood and supported and whether they have meaningful opportunities to learn and thrive.

listItems.title: Enabling learning environment
listItems.description: Do schools and Anganwadi centres provide a safe, inclusive, and well-resourced environment that enables children to learn?

listItems.title: Effective teaching & learning practices
listItems.description: Are teaching and learning practices engaging, inclusive, and responsive to the diverse learning needs of children?

listItems.title: Leadership
listItems.description: Are school and Anganwadi leaders driving continuous improvements?

layers.learner_subheading: Schools and Anganwadi centres shape learner outcomes by creating the day-to-day conditions in which learner learn, participate and develop. The quality of leadership, teaching and learning practices, relationships, and learning environment determines whether learner’s needs are understood and supported and whether they have meaningful opportunities to learn and thrive.
layers.impact_subheading: Measures whether schools and Anganwadi centres are fostering quality learning through effective leadership, enabling learning environments, and strong teaching and learning practices.

layers.heading: Community
layers.subheading: Measures whether communities are actively supporting education through leadership, participation, and positive perceptions of public schools.
layers.body: Communities act as a bridge between schools and learner: when parents and community actors are informed, engaged and invested in learner’s education, they strengthen support for learning at home and in the community, reinforce aspirations, help schools respond to their needs, and contribute to ongoing school improvement.

listItems.title: Parent & community participation and perception
listItems.description: Are parents and communities actively engaged in supporting schools and children's learning?

listItems.title: Leadership
listItems.description: Are community leaders continuously identifying, implementing, and sustaining improvements in their contexts?

layers.learner_subheading: Communities act as a bridge between schools and learner: when parents and community actors are informed, engaged and invested in learner’s education, they strengthen support for learning at home and in the community, reinforce aspirations, help schools respond to their needs, and contribute to ongoing school improvement.
layers.impact_subheading: Measures whether communities are actively supporting education through leadership, participation, and positive perceptions of public schools.

layers.heading: Education Institutions
layers.subheading: Measures whether education institutions are enabling continuous improvement through collaboration, innovation, effective resource mobilisation, and evidence-based decision-making.
layers.body: Education institutions enable and accelerate improvement across education by strengthening the ability of leaders, schools and communities to identify challenges, learn from evidence, take action and sustain what works—helping effective local practices spread across the system.

listItems.title: Budget allocation & resource mobilisation
listItems.description: Are institutions effectively mobilising and utilising resources to strengthen education outcomes?

listItems.title: Review, monitoring & feedback
listItems.description: Are institutions continuously reviewing progress, learning from evidence, and adapting their actions?

listItems.title: Innovation & new projects
listItems.description: Are institutions fostering innovation by initiating, experimenting, and scaling what works?

listItems.title: Co-creation with diverse stakeholders
listItems.description: Are institutions meaningfully collaborating with communities, schools, CSOs, and other stakeholders to design and implement improvement programmes?

layers.learner_subheading: Education institutions enable and accelerate improvement across education by strengthening the ability of leaders, schools and communities to identify challenges, learn from evidence, take action and sustain what works—helping effective local practices spread across the system.
layers.impact_subheading: Measures whether education institutions are enabling continuous improvement through collaboration, innovation, effective resource mobilisation, and evidence-based decision-making.

layers.body: Society shapes the aspirations, norms and opportunities that surround learner. It shapes the broader demand for quality education and the collective willingness to invest in learner’s development.
layers.frameworkNote: Measures whether social norms and perceptions are shifting towards public schools.

layers.heading: Network
layers.subheading: Measures whether the network is growing, strengthening connections, enabling meaningful value exchange, and collectively contributing to education transformation.
layers.body: The network brings together partners and collaborators beyond any single institution or layer to enable meaningful value exchange and collective action. Stronger relationships, collaboration and learning across the network can accelerate problem-solving, spread what works while sustaining collective progress towards education transformation and better learner outcomes.
